extraction.name: OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning
extraction.description: This work enhances OWSM by integrating YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset with a Creative Commons license. A scalable data-cleaning pipeline is developed to address issues such as incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments, yielding a dataset with 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages. The new OWSM v4 models significantly outperform previous versions on multilingual benchmarks and match or surpass frontier industrial models like Whisper and MMS.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.citeAs: Peng, Y., Shakeel, M., Sudo, Y., Chen, W., Tian, J., Lin, C.-J., & Watanabe, S. (2025). OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning. Interspeech 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is derived from YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset. The raw YODAS data has not undergone rigorous cleaning and may contain annotation errors such as mismatched language labels and misalignment between audio and text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YODAS (YouTube-Oriented Dataset for Audio and Speech) provides audio files in a Creative Commons license, covering 370k hours of audio in 149 languages, including unsegmented long-form audio recordings.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data-cleaning pipeline consists of three steps: (1) Resegmentation using CTC segmentation algorithm to realign audio and text, segmenting long-form recordings into utterances up to 30 seconds, and removing non-speech elements. (2) LID-based filtering: retain utterances where the original language label matches both text-based LID (fastText) and spoken LID (ECAPA-TDNN) predictions. (3) CTC-score-based filtering: remove utterances with low-quality audio-text alignments by selecting a relative threshold (θCTC=0.10) within each language, discarding entire long-form utterances if any constituent short utterance falls in the lowest quantile.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (transcriptions) are from YODAS, which provides text transcriptions with start and end timestamps. The timestamps can be inaccurate, so CTC segmentation is used for realignment.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: CTC segmentation algorithm, fastText (text-based LID), ECAPA-TDNN (spoken LID) from SpeechBrain, OWSM-CTC v3.2 model
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The cleaned YODAS data, pre-trained models, and all associated scripts will be publicly released via the ESPnet toolkit.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution across languages is highly imbalanced; English constitutes the largest share, while many other languages are underrepresented. The original distribution is kept without resampling.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to 75 languages after cleaning. The CTC-score-based filtering threshold (θCTC=0.10) is a global choice; finer-grained filtering could potentially optimize performance for individual languages. The raw YODAS data contains substantial misalignment issues.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation; used for multilingual ASR, LID, and ST tasks.
